trial_title: Randomized Study in Children and Adolescents With Migraine: Acute Treatment
brief_summary: The purpose of this study is to test the safety and efficacy of BHV-3000 versus placebo in the acute treatment of moderate or severe migraine in children and adolescents.

eligibility_table.criterion: History of migraine (with or without aura) for > 6 months before Screening according to the IHS Classification ICHD-319 specifications for pediatric migraine. History may be verified using both medical records and recall by the participant and/or participant's parent(s)/legal representative(s).
eligibility_table.justification: The patient has no documented history of migraine, which is a requirement for this criterion.

eligibility_table.criterion: History of 1 to 8 moderate or severe attacks per month during the 2 months prior to enrollment, with attacks lasting > 3 hours without treatment, and attacks occurring at intervals > 24 hours.
eligibility_table.justification: There is no evidence of moderate or severe migraine attacks in the patient's profile.

eligibility_table.criterion: Prophylactic migraine medication are permitted if the dose has been stable for at least 12 weeks prior to the Baseline Visit, and the dose is not expected to change during the course of the study.
eligibility_table.justification: The patient is on pain medication, but there is no indication of any prophylactic migraine medication being used.

eligibility_table.criterion: Participants may remain on one (1) medication with possible migraine prophylactic effects, excluding CGRP antagonists [biologic or small molecule], during the treatment phases.
eligibility_table.justification: The patient is not on any medication with possible migraine prophylactic effects.

eligibility_table.criterion: Concomitant use of a CGRP antagonist, such as erenumab or fremanezumab, is prohibited.
eligibility_table.justification: The patient is not using any CGRP antagonists, but this criterion is irrelevant as the patient does not meet other inclusion criteria.

eligibility_table.criterion: Previously discontinued prophylactic migraine medication must have done so at least 90 days prior to the Screening Visit.
eligibility_table.justification: There is no information on any previously discontinued prophylactic migraine medication.
eligibility_table.clinical_question: Has the patient discontinued any prophylactic migraine medication for at least 90 days prior to the Screening Visit?

eligibility_table.criterion: Verbally distinguish between migraine and other types of headaches.
eligibility_table.justification: The patient has not provided information on distinguishing between migraine and other types of headaches.
eligibility_table.clinical_question: Can the patient accurately describe the characteristics of her headache to distinguish it from tension-type headaches or cluster headaches?

eligibility_table.criterion: Participants must have a weight > 40 kg at the Screening Visit.
eligibility_table.justification: The patient is 32 years old, which exceeds the minimum weight requirement.

eligibility_table.criterion: Adequate venous access for blood sampling.
eligibility_table.justification: There is no information provided regarding the patient's venous access for blood sampling.
eligibility_table.clinical_question: Does the patient have a minimum of one accessible vein suitable for blood sampling in the upper extremities?

eligibility_table.criterion: Male and female participants ≥ 6 to < 18 years of age (participants must not reach their 18th birthday during the study).
eligibility_table.justification: The patient is 32 years old, which does not meet the age requirement of 6 to < 18 years.

eligibility_table.criterion: Male and female participants ≥ 6 to < 18 years of age (participants must not reach their 18th birthday during the study).
eligibility_table.justification: The patient is 32 years old, which is outside the specified age range of 6 to < 18 years.
